notes: Phase 0 baseline: real questions from live testing (2026-10-01) with checked answers. Run through the full HTTP pipeline by scripts/run_baseline_eval.py together with the agent cases in agent_questions.json. Checks: outcome (answered/refused/escalated/clarification_required), must_contain (all), must_contain_any (at least one), must_not_contain, expect_citations (true: at least one source, false: none), limitation_contains, verified_value_not. 'turns' runs earlier messages first in the same conversation.
